verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents agents that claim approved tasks and open pull requests, and it triages customer feedback submissions into intentions. Nothing in the evidence covers ingesting security alerts, validating them, or remediating them automatically. The PR-opening workflow is an adjacent capability driven by human-approved tasks and user feedback, not security alerts, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
